[[Walsh Gymnasium]] | champion = | tourney = [[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] | tourney_result = first round }} {{2021–22 Big East men's basketball standings}} The '''2021–22 Seton Hall Pirates men's basketball team''' represented [[Seton Hall University]] in the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They were led by 12th-year head coach [[Kevin Willard]]. The Pirates played their home games at the [[Prudential Center]] in [[Newark, New Jersey]] and [[Walsh Gymnasium]] in [[South Orange, New Jersey]] as members of the [[Big East Conference]]. They finished the season 21–11, 11–8 in Big East play to finish a tie for fifth place. They defeated [[2021–22 Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball team|Georgetown]] in the first round of the [[2022 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]] before losing in the quarterfinals to [[2021–22 UConn Huskies men's basketball team|UConn]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 8 seed in the South region where they lost in the first round to [[2021–22 TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball team|TCU]]. On March 21, 2022, head coach Kevin Willard left to become the new basketball coach at [[Maryland Terrapins men's basketball|Maryland]].{{Cite web |date=2022-03-21 |title=Terps name Seton Hall's Willard as head coach |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/33563611/maryland-hires-former-seton-hall-coach-kevin-willard-men-basketball-coach |access-date=2022-03-21 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}} On March 31, the school named [[Saint Peter's Peacocks men's basketball|Saint Peter's]] head coach and former Pirate player [[Shaheen Holloway]] the team's new coach. {{cite news |title=Holloway Home! Shaheen Holloway '00 Named Pirates Head Coach |url=https://shupirates.com/news/2022/3/30/holloway-home-shaheen-holloway-named-head-coach-of-seton-hall-mens-basketball.aspx |access-date=30 March 2022 |work=Seton Hall Pirates |date=30 March 2022}} == Previous season == In a season limited due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], the [[2020–21 Seton Hall Pirates men's basketball team|Pirates]] finished the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21 season]] 14–13, 10–9 in [[2020–21 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to finish in a tie for fourth place. As the No. 5 seed in the [[2021 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]], they defeated [[2020–21 St. John's Red Storm men's basketball team|St. John's]] in the quarterfinals before losing to [[2020–21 Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball team|Georgetown]] in the semifinals. == Offseason == === Departures === {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
